Date: 2021-01-15

Visit Type: ed

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Found unconscious in garage with car engine running

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
28-year-old man with asthma, allergic rhinitis, migraine returns one year after similar presentation, brought to the emergency department after being found unconscious in his garage with his car engine running.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Carbon monoxide poisoning (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
- Asthma, mild intermittent
- Allergic rhinitis, seasonal
- Migraine without aura

PAST SURGICAL HISTORY:
- Tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy, age 8
- Open reduction and internal fixation of right distal radius fracture, age 22

MEDICATIONS:
Home Medications:
- Albuterol sulfate inhaler 90 mcg, 2 puffs every 4-6 hours as needed for wheezing
- Fluticasone propionate nasal spray 50 mcg per nostril once daily
- Sumatriptan 50 mg oral as needed for migraine (maximum 2 tablets per day)
- Cetirizine 10 mg oral once daily as needed for allergies

ALLERGIES:
Penicillin (rash), Dust mites, Ragweed pollen

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Father: Hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, age 58
- Mother: Hypothyroidism, migraine disorder, age 55
- Younger brother: Asthma, age 24

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Former smoker, quit age 25. Alcohol: Social (3-4 drinks per week). Occupation: Automotive technician.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On arrival, he is confused and not alert to person, place, or time.

LABORATORY DATA:
Arterial blood gas shows pH 7.40 and pCO 2 of 38 mmHg.

attachments.title: Source clinical note
attachments.text:
ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-01-15
Provider: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD
Department: Emergency Medicine
Visit Type: ed

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Found unconscious in his apartment in midwinter; roommate reports dog lethargic since morning

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
A 27-year-old man is brought to the emergency department in midwinter after being found unconscious in his apartment. The roommate adds that their dog has been unusually lethargic since morning.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Asthma, mild intermittent
- Allergic rhinitis, seasonal
- Migraine without aura

PAST SURGICAL HISTORY:
- Tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy, age 8
- Open reduction and internal fixation of right distal radius fracture, age 22

MEDICATIONS:
Home Medications:
- Albuterol sulfate inhaler 90 mcg, 2 puffs every 4-6 hours as needed for wheezing
- Fluticasone propionate nasal spray 50 mcg per nostril once daily
- Sumatriptan 50 mg oral as needed for migraine (maximum 2 tablets per day)
- Cetirizine 10 mg oral once daily as needed for allergies

ALLERGIES:
Penicillin (rash), Dust mites, Ragweed pollen

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Father: Hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, age 58
- Mother: Hypothyroidism, migraine disorder, age 55
- Younger brother: Asthma, age 24

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Former smoker, quit age 25. Alcohol: Social (3-4 drinks per week). Occupation: Automotive technician.

VITAL SIGNS:
Pulse oximetry displays 97% on room air.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
In the ED he is flushed, diaphoretic, and answers questions slowly. Neurologic exam reveals ataxia and impaired finger‑to‑nose testing without focal weakness. Lungs are clear and cardiac exam is normal.

IMAGING:
Noncontrast head CT is unrevealing. An MRI is obtained. The axial T2/FLAIR sequence shows bilateral symmetric hyperintensity in the globus pallidus.

OTHER STUDIES:
ECG shows sinus tachycardia without acute ischemic changes.
